headline: 美加汽車關稅戰升溫
context: 美加貿易戰持續升溫。川普揚言明年一月起，把汽車、卡車、汽車零件與鋼鐵關稅一口氣調到50%。加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）指控川普是想「摧毀」加拿大汽車產業，強調除非美方帶著「正確的態度」回到談判桌，否則不會恢復貿易談判。

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: Mark Carney accused Trump of wanting to "destroy" Canada's auto industry, and said he would only resume trade talks if the US comes with the "right attitude".
sources.title: US-Canada trade war escalates as Trump threatens tariff hike on vehicles

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: President Trump vowed to increase tariffs on cars, trucks, auto parts and steel to 50 percent starting Jan. 1, as the countries edged toward a full-blown trade war.
sources.title: Trump Threatens New 50% Tariffs on Cars, Trucks and Steel as U.S.-Canada Trade War Unfolds

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A fundamental rupture in the values that have united North America is not a problem that can be wished away: this is a warning to the western alliance The Canadians are exceedingly angry. I realise this can sometimes be difficult for foreigners to deduce, given our national struggle to express the full range of human emotion outside ice hockey riots. However, let me assure you that the prime minister Canadians saw take the stage on Saturday morning in the wake of the collapse in trade negotiations with the US was a Mark Carney practically vibrating with fury. “You’re at war when you get attacked. We got attacked,” he said , in a rare press conference that was as candid and clear as he ever tends to be. “That’s fine … We’ve got the reserves, we’ve got the resilience, we’ve got the plan, we’ve got the focus. We’re gonna respond, we’re going to focus on what we can control and what we’re going to build.” Jen Gerson is a Canadian commentator and co-founder of The Line . She lives in Calgary, Alberta Continue reading...
sources.title: Canadians do not seek a trade war – but nor will we be bullied by Donald Trump | Jen Gerson

thread_text: 美加貿易戰持續升溫，川普揚言，明年一月一日起把汽車、卡車、汽車零件與鋼鐵的關稅一口氣調高到50%。加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）批評，這是想「摧毀」加拿大的汽車產業，並表示除非美方帶著「正確的態度」回來，否則加拿大不會恢復貿易談判。
threads_text: 美加貿易戰持續升溫，川普揚言，明年一月一日起把汽車、卡車、汽車零件與鋼鐵的關稅一口氣調高到50%。加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）批評，這是想「摧毀」加拿大的汽車產業，並表示除非美方帶著「正確的態度」回來，否則加拿大不會恢復貿易談判。上週雙方貿易談判破局後，卡尼罕見地在記者會上直言「我們被攻擊了」，強調加拿大有足夠的資源與韌性應對這場衝突。
voice_text: 美加的汽車關稅戰，又更緊張了。川普放話，明年一月起要把汽車、卡車、零件跟鋼鐵的關稅，一口氣調到50%。加拿大總理卡尼批評，這根本是想「摧毀」加拿大的汽車產業，還說除非美國帶著正確的態度回來，不然他不會恢復談判。
